About Ecommerce360

Ecommerce360 is a customer-intelligence console built from raw invoice-level transaction data for a UK-based online retailer. Every line item — an invoice, a stock item, a quantity, a price — is rolled up into an RFM-style profile per customer: how recently they bought, how often, and how much they spent.

From that profile the console defines churn as a customer with no purchase in the 90 days before the dataset's last recorded invoice date, and trains a logistic regression classifier — entirely in your browser, with no server or backend — to estimate the probability that a customer matching a given behavior profile has churned.

Every number on this page — KPIs, charts, model metrics — is computed live from the dataset currently loaded. Nothing is hardcoded or simulated.

Methodology

    Limitations

    • The dataset spans roughly one year of transactions from a single UK retailer — patterns may not generalize to other markets or seasons.
    • ~25% of line items have no Customer ID and are excluded from customer-level analysis (they still count toward revenue and product KPIs).
    • The model is a linear logistic regression trained with a fixed number of gradient-descent iterations in-browser — it favors transparency and speed over the accuracy a tuned, server-trained model could reach.
    • The 90-day churn threshold is a business rule, not a ground-truth label — a different cutoff would shift which customers are considered churned.
